text.p: Thailand, grappling with an economic crisis, on Wednesday announced that the baht will now trade under a "managed float" system. The news caused the currency to plunge in the offshore market.
The Bank of Thailand raised its key bank rate to 12.5 percent from 10.5 percent.

In the Philippines the peso was hit by ripples from the Thai announcement. The Philippine Central Bank vowed to defend the peso and sold U.S. dollars and raised interest rates in a bid to counter speculative attacks.
Reuters will have updates throughout the day from the region's markets. We will also be looking at any announcements about the future of the present two-tier market in Thailand.
